collection.title: Mini Hatch 2012 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mini Cooper/One Hatchback 2012 - 2014 model requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment. We also have the rear blade available for this Mini Cooper, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
